draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield: your first project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for your question about API rate limits -- Tariq shared that API rate limits scale with plan tier, with Pro and Team getting higher limits than Starter, and that ticket is still open if anything there is unclear.

On setup: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first project in place is usually the quickest way to see value. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
